description: Find and redact personal data and secrets in text before an agent stores, logs or forwards it: emails, phone numbers, US SSNs, payment cards (Luhn-checked), IBANs (checksum), IPs, crypto addresses, dates of birth, street addresses, API keys, tokens and private keys, plus person names and free-form addresses from an LLM pass. Returns the redacted text ([EMAIL] labels or masks), each entity with its position, and counts. Costs $0.005 USDC on Base via x402.

model.description: Also find names and free-form addresses with the LLM (default true)

style.description: label: [EMAIL] (default); mask: ****, keeping a card's last 4

text.description: The text to scan, up to 50,000 characters

types.description: Comma list to limit the search (email, phone, us_ssn, credit_card, iban, ip_address, crypto_address, date_of_birth, street_address, secret, person_name, postal_address)

name: pii_redact
